name: Benjamin

entries: Benjamin, son of the right hand

identification.note: The tribal territory of Benjamin, distinct from the patriarch Benjamin himself.

description: The territory of the tribe of Benjamin, between Judah and Ephraim, birthplace and home territory of Israel's first king, Saul's father Kish among them (1 Samuel 9:1-2).

geo.note: Approximate: the tribal territory north of Jerusalem.
